usedFor: Paymo holds projects and tasks for tracking time, and Todoist gets the matching task through “Create Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task” in Paymo, then “Create Task” in Todoist
bestTemplate.why: A task added in Paymo shows up in Todoist with its title and details, so one entry serves both.

watchOut: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist is polling, so a Paymo task made from it follows a scheduled check.
